title: Microsoft SharePoint WorkflowCompilerInternal Exposed Dangerous Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft SharePoint. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the System.Workflow.ComponentModel.Compiler.WorkflowCompilerInternal class. This class allows an attacker to specify a path to an arbitrary workflow definition file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web service account.
